findings.detail: Milestone Technologies, Inc. Delayed Draw Term Loan stores cost as -6466, but the current-period amortized cost cell is blank/dash and -6466 appears in the comparative fair value column.

rationale: C107 flagged ten negative cost rows. The raw schedule shows many flagged negatives are legitimate negative amortized costs, but one flagged row is a real data error: Milestone Technologies, Inc. Delayed Draw Term Loan has no current-period amortized cost in table 8 row 19, while the stored observed cost -6466 matches the comparative schedule value shown in table 13 row 22. Therefore the package contains a source-grounded extraction/comparative-period leak, not a pure false alarm.
